Candidates write a longer piece of continuous prose of approximately 200 words. The topic was found to be
engaging for almost all the candidates. Most candidates discussed both sides of the given statement and
provided a logical conclusion. The quality of written work is variable. More attention to spelling and a range of
correct grammatical structures will further raise the standards of IGCSE Hindi as a Second Language.
